about: Hand-labelled pairs of picture-library cards (TEACH-84): the card is bankCard(imageBrief) = 'subject: mustShow items', the shape Plan's image briefs have on master. same = one photograph serves both briefs; near = the same topic, but a different photograph is needed (reusing would be wrong); different = unrelated. Labelled by the implementer from the briefs' wording, 7 Oct 2026.
